definitions.gloss: to brace oneself, to prepare oneself (physically)
definitions.explanation: To take a defensive or ready posture in preparation for something. Often used in martial arts or physical confrontation contexts.

definitions.gloss: to be on guard, to tense up (psychologically)
definitions.explanation: To mentally prepare for something or to become tense/defensive in anticipation. Can imply excessive caution.

examples.japanese: ⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{身構|みがま}える
examples.english: to brace oneself against an enemy

notes:
FORMATION: Compound of ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧ (body) + ⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to set up, take a stance).

TRANSITIVITY: Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧).

CONJUGATION: Ichidan verb: {身構|みがま}えない, {身構|みがま}えます, {身構|みがま}えて.

USAGE: Often used in the negative sense of being too tense or overly defensive. {身構|みがま}えすぎる (to be too on guard) is a common pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {身構|みがま}える⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (no need to be on guard)
- {身構|みがま}えすぎる (to be too tense/defensive)
- ～⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{身構|みがま}える (to brace against ~)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to take a stance - base verb)
- ⟦{警戒|けいかい}する→警戒する：25375_keikaisuru⟧ (to be on guard - more formal)
- ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}する→緊張する：20557_kinchousuru⟧ (to be nervous/tense)
